name: aicmm-mcp-server
description: AiCMM Agent Capability Maturity Model - MCP Server for creating, scoring, and managing Agent Cards

tools.name: aicmm_create_card
tools.description: Create a new AiCMM Agent Card with 12-dimension capability profile, avatar, tools, skills, plugins, MCPs, and agent relationships

capabilityProfile.description: 12 Level 0 dimensions, each with position (0-11), score (0-5), confidence, evidence

tools.name: aicmm_inspect_agent
tools.description: Inspect an AI agent from its URL or description and generate a suggested AiCMM capability profile with 12-dimension scores

url.description: URL to agent documentation or homepage

description.description: Text description of the agent's capabilities

tools.name: aicmm_validate_card
tools.description: Validate an Agent Card against AiCMM schema and governance rules (Autonomy-Reasoning Foundation, Explainability Gate, Safety Gate, etc.)

card.description: The full agent card JSON to validate

tools.name: aicmm_score_card
tools.description: Score/re-score an agent card and return governance validation results

tools.name: aicmm_list_cards
tools.description: List all Agent Cards in the AiCMM catalog with summary info

tools.name: aicmm_get_card
tools.description: Get full details of a specific Agent Card by name

tools.name: aicmm_get_dimensions
tools.description: Get the full AiCMM dimension definitions including Level 0 (12 dims) and Level 1 domain-specific dimensions with scoring rubrics

domain.description: For Level 1: healthcare, transportation, finance, manufacturing, education, customer-service

tools.name: aicmm_get_schema
tools.description: Get the JSON schema for AiCMM Agent Cards (v0.2.0)

tools.name: aicmm_get_agency_levels
tools.description: Get the Agency Qualification ladder (derived 13th dimension, position 12): levels -2 (Scripted Automation) and -1 (Reactive Assistant) for non-agents, through 0 (Proto-Agent), 1 (Basic), 2 (Advanced), 3 (Generalized), 4 (Human-Level), and 5 (Humanoid Agent)
